messages:
mike: Heads-up — planning to deploy v2.7.3 to prod tomorrow 09:30 PT. Quick checklist: smoke, canary, docs publish, CS/marketing notif. Who can own smoke checks and rollback readiness? :eyes:
elaine: I can own customer comms + docs publish. Will draft the blurb after the deploy plan is final.
priyanka: I'll be on-call for CS triage during the window. Please @me when rollout starts.
mike: Thanks Elaine/Pris. @sam can you take smoke checks and verify metrics dashboards? smoke steps below:

```
# smoke checklist
1. curl -sS https://api.redwood.example/health | jq .status == "ok"
2. run sample gen: curl -X POST /v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' | jq .choices[0].text
3. check latency: prometheus query: rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])
```

sam: Yup I can run those. I'll also validate token/account-scoped routing for tenants A/B. ETA 09:40 PT for sign-off.

mike: Rollback plan: immediate rollback to v2.7.2 image, disable new route, and invalidate caches. Rollback command (ops-only):

```
kubectl set image deploy/inference inference=image:redwood/v2.7.2 --namespace=prod
kubectl rollout status deploy/inference --namespace=prod
```

mike: We'll keep a 30-minute canary (5% traffic) then ramp if no errors. If any 500s or latency > 2x P95, rollback.
jordan: I'll own rollout automation and will trigger the canary. Will post the canary URL and traces in this thread when started.

deploy-bot: dry-run deployment scheduled at 2026-03-18T09:20:00Z (will post logs).

elaine: For marketing: short paragraph ready to go once Sam confirms smoke pass. Priyanka, want me to loop support channels now or wait for canary pass?

priyanka: Loop support now with a heads-up and the expected window. We'll wait to post public-facing notes until canary passes.

sam: Smoke passed locally against canary endpoint. Latency looks OK (~120ms p95). No errors in logs. Ready to greenlight.
mike: Great — Jordan, proceed with canary at 09:30 PT. @elaine queue the PR for docs publish, @priyanka share the CS brief. Everyone, please react with :thumbsup: once you're monitoring.
jordan: Canary started — canary URL: https://canary.redwood.example/trace/abc123. Posting trace dashboard in #observability.

priyanka: Monitoring — nothing alarming. Will escalate if tickets hit.

elaine: Docs PR merged, marketing blurb posted to the release channel.

sam: Canary 15m check: error rate 0.03%, latency stable. Green from me.
mike: Ramping to 50% now. If steady at +30m, full rollout.

jordan: Ramp complete to 100%. All pods updated.

deploy-bot: deployment v2.7.3 completed at 2026-03-18T10:15:00Z.

priyanka: Noticing a small uptick in support mentions about token refresh UI. Filing a short FAQ and assigning to frontend.

mike: Noted. Thanks team — great coordination. Post-mortem not needed but we'll log the release notes and a tiny follow-up for the token refresh doc. :tada:
